Animal.description: Deep connection to beasts featuring a powerful loyal animal companion.

features.name: Animal Order
features.tldr: Gain Athletics training, the Animal Companion feat, and the Heal Animal focus spell.

Leaf.description: Warden of flora and plant life accompanied by a leshy familiar.

features.name: Leaf Order
features.tldr: Gain Diplomacy training, the Leshy Familiar feat, and the Goodberry focus spell.

Storm.description: Channeler of weather fury, lightning, and destructive winds.

features.name: Storm Order
features.tldr: Gain Acrobatics training, the Storm Born feat, and the Tempest Surge focus spell.

Untamed.description: Shapeshifting master of natural forms and wild combat adaptation.

features.name: Untamed Order
features.tldr: Gain Intimidation training, the Untamed Form feat, and the Untamed Shift focus spell.
